completion.summary:
Complete source-only attack surface analysis of Acme Corp corporate application. 52 topology records persisted (4 boundaries, 9 components, 12 flows, 10 controls, 15 threats) with zero structural issues. Report finalized with all test targets scoped to authorized origin http://portal.corp.localtest.me:18080. Internal-only services documented in the topology map but excluded from recommended test targets.

Boundaries: VPC-equivalent Docker network with DMZ, Corp (internal), and Mgmt (internal) subnets. Components: Edge Nginx, Portal, Intranet, PostgreSQL, VPN, SSH Jump, Gitea, Backup Server, Grafana. Controls: 10 documented including critical gaps (XFF trust, absent TLS, absent secret management, no intranet auth). Threats: 15 source-supported threats across STRIDE categories.

Justified absence: No cloud boundaries (Docker Compose deployment). No WAF/logging/authorization controls because none exist in source. Runtime state (Grafana datasources, WireGuard keys) not in source.

scores.caveat: Regex coverage only. Native record componentId mapped to scorer component id. Includes failed runs when output exists; no latest-success filtering.

manualReview.scope: One source-only segmented-corporate pilot per arm, same model and merged tree. No live target requests. Manual review is not blind or exhaustive.

goalFindings.observation: Entry point and first attack step propose direct PostgreSQL access via portal SSRF; likelihood rationale explicitly says that SSRF is HTTP-only and cannot provide direct PostgreSQL access. VPN-based access is a separate valid conditional path.

Potential SSTI is based on a constant PAGE template rendered with user/news as context data. No attacker-controlled template source or second render is shown; the text incorrectly treats HTML autoescaping as what prevents template re-evaluation.
Local-file/non-HTTP SSRF path is proposed despite using stock requests.get and acknowledging HTTP/HTTPS-only support. Cloud metadata existence is also not established by this Docker fixture.
goalFindings.offlineCheck: Installed requests 2.32.5 has only http/https adapters and get_adapter(file:/gopher:) raises InvalidSchema without making any network requests. Fixture pins another requests patch version; this is not live fixture validation.

goalFindings.observation: Accepted goal summary claims 15 threats; active topology contains 17.
Both rely on the same hardcoded SSH credential and jump-host access. One names backup access, the other a broader pivot. Treat as overlapping paths, not two independent entry mechanisms.

goalRejections: Attempt 1: retained deterministic target-scope guard rejected unauthorized recommended origins; adapter replaced the claim evidence with an empty list, producing a misleading no-evidence prefix alongside the accurate scope reasons.
Attempts 2 and 3: Jorge citation matcher rejected nonexistent list_files quote count:52.
Attempt 4: citations accepted; semantic issues remained.
scorerCaveats: 10 matched component patterns does not imply 10 separately modeled components: goal output has nine.
The missing Postgres threat-pattern match is a wording false negative: the scenario says credentials rather than password.
All 17 goal threats satisfy structural testability fields despite unsupported or contradictory scenarios.
Audit draft matches 12/12 threat patterns and all 18 threats meet structural fields, despite unsupported scenarios and no final report.
manualReview.pilotImplementation: The archived implementation snapshots are authoritative for the run. The subsequently pushed adapter adds a read-only wrap-up roster and preserves the kickoff/evidence window on resume; neither wrap-up nor resume executed in the completed goal pilot.
manualReview.conclusion: Do not equate goal status complete, valid citations or field-complete threats with demonstrated comprehensive quality.

auditFindings.kind: unsupported and internally contradictory threat path
auditFindings.observation: Attack step claims a forged user context value executes Jinja2 expressions; likelihood rationale correctly says a constant PAGE template does not re-parse that value. The first audit explicitly endorsed this as satisfactory rather than removing the unsupported path. It remained in the terminal draft.

Calls HTTP GET SSRF returning at most 500 characters a complete network proxy and full internal network compromise. Internal HTTP data exposure is supported; arbitrary protocol access and full compromise are not established.

Open registration is configured, but repository visibility, existing users, admin bootstrap state and CI/CD links are not established. Some caveats are present, while the scenario still says browse all repositories and become first-user admin.

The report audit marked nine targets correctly scoped while the deterministic guard rejected eight unauthorized recommended origins. Read-only audit judgments are not a substitute for deterministic authorization checks.

auditTerminal.lastAuditSnapshot: Earlier report/map; not a completed audit of the final retained draft.

validationLimitations: No live fixture tests were run.
A proposed offline template rendering check could not run because Jinja2 was not installed; the SSTI judgment is based on the supplied source and the generated records themselves.
